name: monarchTextStyle(_:)
title: Text
summary: Applies one of the nine Monarch type roles (size, weight, tracking, line spacing) to text.
whenToUse: On every Text that should follow Monarch typography.
whenNotToUse: Do not set a fixed font size beside it. Leave navigation bar titles and other system chrome to the system fonts.
api: func monarchTextStyle(_ style: MonarchTextStyle) -> some View

options.name: style
options.description: display, title, heading, subheading, body, bodyStrong, label, caption, code, codeSmall, bodySmall (14 points) or bodyExtraSmall (12 points).

appearance: Sets no colour. Text keeps the foreground style of its container; use a text role from theme.colors.
platformNotes: The web Text component also sets tone, weight and truncation; on iOS those stay the standard Text modifiers (foregroundStyle, lineLimit). Android ships a MonarchText composable; iOS ships a modifier because SwiftUI Text is already the component.
accessibility: Every role scales with Dynamic Type, including the accessibility sizes, for the system font and for a custom family.
Colour is not set by the modifier, so text keeps the foreground style of its container.
edgeCases: Line height is approximated: SwiftUI takes extra line spacing, so only the part of the token line height above 1.2 times the size is added.
On the macOS host build ScaledMetric does not scale; the growth test runs on the simulator.
